title: Understanding Astrology
sub: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 1 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. Prarabdha and free will, human consciousness, the body as planetary portals, twelve signs, Neptune's grace, the deity at home and Vastu zones.
desc: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 1, Understanding Astrology by Brajesh Gautam: fate and prarabdha, asking big, planets in the body, the twelve signs, Varuna and Vastu, with video timestamps.
points: Astrology is true, astrologers can be false.
Doubt one doctor, not medicine. The aim is grace, not becoming an astrologer.
About 12 percent of life is fixed (prarabdha).
The rest follows your commands and reactions. To end old karma, do not react.
No negatives in a wish. The planets deliver the size of your first ask.
The body is a set of planet portals.
Mars at the navel, Jupiter at the liver, Saturn at the bones. Pain marks the portal that is off.
Rahu, Ketu, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto each take a sign.
Set the west of the home. Without grace every other tool misses.
Do not build a temple inside the home.
Keep the deity your chart supports. God is neutral, karma is yours.
